mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notice WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY is_important DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT n.num, n.id, n.title, n.content, n.view_count as viewCount, n.is_planned as isPlanned, n.is_important as isImportant, n.created_at as createdAt, n.updated_at as updatedAt, n.is_deleted as isDeleted, f.file_path as imagePath FROM notice n LEFT JOIN notice_file f ON n.num = f.num WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.is_planned = 1 ORDER BY n.created_at DESC Limit 4

SELECT n.num, n.id, n.title, n.content, n.view_count, n.is_planned, n.is_important, n.created_at, n.updated_at, n.is_deleted, f.file_path AS image_path FROM notice n LEFT JOIN notice_file f ON n.num = f.num WHERE n.num = #{num} AND n.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE num = #{num}
UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_planned = #{isPlanned}, is_important = #{isImportant}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE num = #{num} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE notice SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE num = #{num}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice_file ( fd_filepath_img, num, save_name, file_size, file_path ) VALUES ( #{fdFilepathImg}, #{num}, #{saveName}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath} )
